propositions: The process-global dedupe set _DRIFT_WARNED persists across tests in test_status_mapping.py, causing test-order-dependent failures when a drift warning assertion depends on an earlier test not having already recorded that status.
Adding an autouse fixture that calls outbound_mapper.reset_drift_warnings() before each test isolates test state and eliminates the order-dependency without modifying production code.
An oracle test pair (one that records a drift, one that asserts the warning fires) demonstrates the fixture is necessary: the second test fails RED without the fixture and passes GREEN with it.
No changes to outbound_mapper.py production code are required; the public reset_drift_warnings() entry point already exists and is reused by the new fixture.
